description: Sign off a completed run with a name and a date, which freezes it. Refused while a required step is unanswered or failed, unless force is true, and either way the exceptions stay on the record and print on the report.

by.description: Who is signing it off, as it should read on the document

date.description: The day it was signed, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

force.description: Sign off even though required steps are unanswered or failed. Default false; the reasons come back either way

note.description: What the signature covers, or the exception being accepted

run.description: The run id, e.g. RUN-2026-0001, or its title when only one carries it

name: run_sign_off
title: Sign off a run
